item.title: Anti-Israel Incitement in Italy: Israeli Consul Branded A “War Criminal”
item.description: A radical political campaign in Italy’s Tuscany region against Israel’s honorary consul Marco Carrai has sparked outrage. The controversy erupted after posters appeared across the town of Sesto Fiorentino and on social media on International Holocaust Remembrance Day. item.title: Amazon in Talks to Invest Up to $50B in OpenAI
item.description: Amazon is in talks to invest up to $50 billion in OpenAI, according to the report. The discussions are ongoing, and no final agreement has been reached. The potential investment would deepen ties between Amazon and OpenAI as competition intensifies in artificial intelligence.

item.title: Carlyle Group to Buy Lukoil’s Foreign Assets in $22B Deal Amid Sanctions
item.description: US private equity firm Carlyle Group has agreed to buy most of Lukoil’s foreign assets, initially valued at $22 billion by analysts, which Russia’s second-largest oil company must sell because of US sanctions.

item.title: Britain, China Signal Reset as Starmer and Xi Agree to Boost Cooperation
item.description: Britain and China signaled improved relations as Prime Minister Keir Starmer and President Xi Jinping agreed to deepen cooperation in trade, investment, and technology for shared economic gains.
